gameDescriptionHtml:
Exovoid Carnage is an intense WAVE-BASED ARENA SHOOTER that cranks up the chaos to eleven! SHOOT! SHRED! SURVIVE!

You’re dropped onto the colossal Leviathan Station, an alien fortress the size of a planet. Armed with only a gun and no time to lose, you’re launched into a relentless fight for survival. Battle through waves of vicious aliens, blast your way to victory, and get catapulted to the next room!

Equip game-changing power-ups like Rapid Fire, Double Damage, and the devastating Saw-blade Tornado. As you progress, the enemies get fiercer, but so do you. Every death means a new chance to try again with advantages based on your previous run.

How far can you go? Sharpen your skills, beat your high score, and see if you have what it takes to survive EXOVOID CARNAGE!
